governance_reference.owner_decision_this_mission: APPROVE fixed extension blocks of 20 completed FX market weekdays -- resolves the EXTENSION_CHECKPOINT_REQUIRES_OWNER_FREEZE flag raised by the prior checkpoint artifact.
governance_reference.forward_reference_not_rewrite: This document is an ADDITIVE governance artifact. It does not edit HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md's existing text (Sections 1-21 remain exactly as frozen and hashed above); it supplies the extension-block-size parameter that document's Section 7 left as a forward reference ('a later extension may append the next contiguous... interval under the SAME frozen protocol') without pinning a number.

block_size_policy.block_length_selection_rule: Derived ONLY from the frozen calendar/data-availability convention already used for CONFIRM_001 (Mon-Fri weekday counting, 'latest fully completed UTC day' admission rule). Never derived from occurrence count, profitability, MFE, MAE, setup composition, or CONTROL/TREATMENT performance.

blocks.note: Frozen by the prior ACQUISITION_CHECKPOINT_POLICY.json (7c1f94b). Not modified here.

blocks.derivation: Next 20 eligible Mon-Fri calendar dates strictly after CONFIRM_001's end_date (2026-10-12), same counting rule as CONFIRM_001. Known full market closures encountered at actual acquisition time are excluded per the repository's frozen market-day handling rule and reported separately -- this enumeration is not compensated for strategy activity.
Next 20 eligible Mon-Fri calendar dates strictly after CONFIRM_002's end_date (2026-11-09), same counting rule.

maximum_horizon.CONFIRM_004_prohibition: No CONFIRM_004 or any further block may be created under HYP_001's current preregistration. The evidence horizon is capped at 60 completed FX market weekdays across exactly 3 blocks.

cumulative_evidence_contract.occurrence_identity: Deterministic, reusing the existing unmodified v1.0.0 canonical occurrence/campaign identity scheme (per HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md Section 8). No occurrence may be duplicated across blocks -- each occurrence belongs to exactly one block by construction (its own entry_time falls within exactly one block's non-overlapping date range).
cumulative_evidence_contract.immutability: No historical block may be modified after admission. Each block retains its own dataset fingerprint, manifest hash, and population hash independently; a later block's admission or evaluation never alters an earlier block's already-frozen artifacts.
cumulative_evidence_contract.cumulative_hash_requirement: The cumulative population evaluated at each checkpoint (i.e. the union of all admitted blocks up to and including that checkpoint) must itself receive a deterministic hash at evaluation time, computed over the ordered union of the constituent blocks' own occurrence records -- to be produced by the mission that performs that checkpoint's evaluation, not fabricated here since no block has been admitted yet.

checkpoint_decision_logic.rule: At each predetermined checkpoint (after CONFIRM_001 alone, after CONFIRM_001+CONFIRM_002, after CONFIRM_001+CONFIRM_002+CONFIRM_003 -- evaluated in that order, never out of order): IF cumulative TREATMENT_N < 20 AND additional frozen blocks remain: INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE_AT_CHECKPOINT, continue to the next block. IF cumulative TREATMENT_N >= 20: apply the primary economic rule EXACTLY ONCE (PASS: TREATMENT_net_expectancy_R>0 AND delta_net_expectancy_R>0; FAIL: TREATMENT_net_expectancy_R<=0 OR delta_net_expectancy_R<=0), then STOP confirmation permanently -- do not continue to later blocks seeking a different result, even if further blocks remain unused.
checkpoint_decision_logic.pre_adequacy_inspection_scope: At a checkpoint below N=20 adequacy, only occurrence count and provenance required to determine adequacy may be inspected -- never economic PASS/FAIL, never net_expectancy_R, never delta.

no_optional_stopping_rule.statement: Once a block's predetermined full market-day window begins acquisition, that ENTIRE window must be admitted before its checkpoint is evaluated -- a block is never truncated early because occurrence #20 (or any other count) is reached partway through it. Example: if occurrence #20 appears halfway through CONFIRM_002, CONFIRM_002 is still acquired and admitted in full through 2026-11-09 before the checkpoint-2 cumulative population is evaluated once.
no_optional_stopping_rule.purpose: Prevents occurrence-driven endpoint selection -- the block boundary is fixed by the calendar alone, never by watching the occurrence counter during acquisition.

final_inconclusive_rule.condition: Cumulative TREATMENT_N remains < 20 after CONFIRM_001 + CONFIRM_002 + CONFIRM_003 (the full 60-market-weekday horizon) have all been admitted and evaluated.
prohibited_responses: add CONFIRM_004 or any further block
modify setup rules (S1/S2/S3 admission, entry, stop, regime)
use GBPUSD to supplement the sample
final_inconclusive_rule.interpretation: This terminal state means the hypothesis could not obtain its preregistered economic sample size within the prospectively frozen evidence horizon -- it is a statement about occurrence frequency, not about the exit-capture mechanism's economic merit. It does not validate, invalidate, or otherwise economically evaluate HYP_001.

block_calendar_derivation_rule.method: Each block after the first is derived as: previous_block.end_date, then the NEXT 20 eligible completed Mon-Fri market dates strictly after it, under the identical frozen counting convention used for CONFIRM_001 (no FX-specific bank-holiday calendar precommitted at the mechanical-freeze stage; a date later found to be a known full market closure at actual acquisition time is excluded from that block's admitted set and reported separately per the repository's existing GEN_002/FRESH_DATA_ADMISSION gap-diagnostic convention -- it does not shift the block's calendar START/END dates already frozen here, and is never compensated for by strategy activity).
block_calendar_derivation_rule.hardcoded_dates_note: CONFIRM_002 and CONFIRM_003's start/end dates ARE mechanically derivable today without any outcome information (pure calendar arithmetic from CONFIRM_001's already-frozen end date) and are therefore enumerated explicitly above, exactly as the mission instructs -- not deferred.

confirm_001_unchanged.note: This document governs extension behavior AFTER CONFIRM_001 only. CONFIRM_001's own already-frozen fields are reproduced here for reference and were not edited.
